stem: Claire wants to strengthen the focus of her story. Which of the following is the BEST replacement for sentence 10?

options.label: A
options.text: Being at camp had been a wonderful experience for Jared and the other kids.

options.label: B
options.text: Jared was sometimes a little afraid to do things he had never done before.

options.label: C
options.text: Today was Jared’s last chance to overcome his fear and give rappelling a try.

options.label: D
options.text: Even though the others had been rappelling down the side of the cliff, Jared didn’t want to.
